newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's ICC Bank signs 50 mln punts loan facilit.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's ICC Bank signs 50 mln punts loan facilit.

text.p: Ireland's ICC Bank on Thursday signed a new global loan facility for 50 million Irish pounds with the European Investment Bank, Martin Cahill, General Manager of ICC Bank Group Treasury, said.

"The additional funding will enable us to extend our range of innovative lending products to meet the specific needs of small and medium sized business," Cahill said. Cahill said the finance was available through ICC Bank's branch network including its Belfast office.
